Messages.Author: Michael Gerdau
Messages.Body:
Hi!
The following situation:

In two consecutive rounds I play "Short Term Investment" during my master
phase.
a) Am I allowed to draw two blood for the following three rounds or
b) is drawing blood from a "Short Term Investment" the same as playing
a Mastercard in terms of drawing blood from the second card, therefor
allowing to draw one blood for the following six rounds ?

I think ruling b) is the logical one and in my opinion a) would make
"Short Term Investment" and "Protrected Investment" far too powerful.

Any comments ???

Bye, Michael

From: aa...@hal.COM (Tom Wylie)
Newsgroups: rec.games.deckmaster
Subject: NEW: Rulings summary for Jyhad
Date: 9 Nov 1994 13:11:24 -0800

Protracted Investment:
See "Short Term Investment" for rulings on this card.

Short Term Investment:
If a player has multiple master actions, can take multiple counters off of
Investment(s). This is not possible if an out-of-turn Master card has
been played, as that burns the entire master phase, not just an action.
Because it says "take a counter off *the* Short Term Investment", you
cannot take counters off multiple Investments if you only give up
one master action to do so.
